LESSON: OBSERVING AND ARTICULATING SIGNS 2.1.1 OBSERVING FOR COMPREHENSION

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.1: Observing and Articulating signs 2.1.1 Observing for comprehension
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Observing and Articulating signs 2.1.1 Observing for comprehension, part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: What do we do when a story is signed ? 2. Which things are found in our surroundings ?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Observing and Articulating signs 2.1.1 Observing for comprehension together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and Collaboration: Observational skills as learner observes the story and answers signed questions.

● Critical thinking and Problem solving: Observing actively and communication skills as learner signs poems about the

neighbourhood.

Values:
● Unity: Cooperation as learner works together with others in groups to answer questions asked.

● Respect: Patience as learner answers oral and signed questions in an orderly manner while taking turns.

PCIs:

15

Social cohesion as learners collaboratively observes and retells as they sign stories about things in the neighbourhood.

Link to other Activity Areas:

Learner relates story about things in the neighbourhood with story on neighborhood in Environmental Activities.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Adapted course book, Signed audio visual story clips, books, flash cards, video games, pictures, relevant digital devices.
